admission.justification: Collecting an abandoned but worked grant would weaken the immutable post-start authority boundary.

applicability: Architect-owned per-task reclamation of abandoned grant records.
conditions: The leaf is genuinely never worked despite its abandoned status label.
The relevant checkouts are determinably clean.
exclusions: Started or Completed leaves, uncertain bindings, dirty or undeterminable checkouts are preserved.
Legacy unaddressed filename fallback is not a universal constant-I/O promise.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_direct_execution_grants.py::test_reclaim_preserves_abandoned_leaf_with_seat_evidence, test_reclaim_preserves_abandoned_leaf_with_turn_report, test_reclaim_preserves_abandoned_leaf_with_unreadable_locator, test_reclaim_preserves_started_abandoned_leaf; R5 operation-proofs.json F09-started-census; worker journal R6 successor section; R5 verdict 88c054160ffdffef415a01cdf0f09161bb59aa68944469379856e72944c46755

statement: Reclamation takes back only never-worked abandoned grants with determinably clean checkouts, because startedness is read from the ordinary unstarted proof with status words masked away, preserving seat-, report- and locator-started leaves under rule 5.
